Hi Ari — thanks for trying out the site earlier and for the quick signal through the widget. I’m Hannah on the SDR team at Redwood Inference. Would love to get 30 minutes on the calendar to show a short demo tailored to the FinLytics use case you noted (low-latency inference + secure deployment).

Short options (all 30 min):
- Tue 7/27 10:00–10:30 AM ET
- Wed 7/28 10:00–10:30 AM ET
- Thu 7/29 11:00–11:30 AM ET

If those don’t work, tell me 2 windows that do and I’ll send an invite. If Calendly is easier, here’s a link: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min

Attached a one-pager so you have quick context. If you have specific security questions ahead of time, flag them and I’ll pull in our compliance lead.

Best,

hannah@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0123

- We’re evaluating a few vendors; can you include a short SOC2 summary or security brief in the invite? Our InfoSec reviewer will want it.
